title: Aya Model: An Instruction Finetuned Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
measurement_description: Toxicity detection and representational bias in open-ended text generations for identity groups, including religious groups. This involved prompting the models with neutral descriptive sentences related to religious practitioners and evaluating the Expected Maximum Toxicity (EMT) and Toxicity Probability of the generated completions.
findings: For identity groups (which include religious groups), both Aya and Aya Safe models showed lower average expected maximum toxicity and toxicity probability compared to mT0x across all evaluated languages, with the exception of English. The paper did not provide specific numerical or qualitative findings for individual religious groups beyond this general trend for identity groups.
